text:
lia: Product asked for a "dampening" mode to avoid oscillating cache-crediting when short bursts flip prefetch behavior. Need telemetry fields + console plan. tagging @kevin and @sara

kevin: Proposal: add `credit_policy` (enum: legacy|dampen), `pending_credit_usd` (float), `dampening_state` (cooldown|applying|settled). Keep absent = legacy.

sara: Console UX: add a muted column "Provisional savings" with hover text "Provisional: applying over time to avoid invoice churn". Header toggle: [Include provisional savings in totals].

jorge: Infra note: router will need short-lived per-route state for dampening windows (N mins). This increases telemetry cardinality; we should cap distinct policy variants.

maria: Rollout idea: gate behind feature flag per-tenant. Canary-bot: ff/dampen-credit-route created at 1771010000 :white_check_mark:

kevin: Backfill plan: synthesize `dampening_state` from historical hit-rate windows but mark records with `source:backfill` so downstream knows it's estimated. Publish schema v2 with migration notes.

sara: Quick SQL sketch for the mock: SELECT route_id, SUM(allocated_usd) AS allocated, SUM(pending_credit_usd) AS pending FROM cost_windows WHERE window_ts > now() - interval '3 days' GROUP BY route_id;

lia: Product decision: default internal-only, opt-in per-tenant for customers. Owners: kevin=telemetry+backfill, jorge=infra+gating, sara=console+queries. Sync Friday 10am. Thanks :rocket:
